# Shatter

**Shatter** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Glass shards break away from the point of impact. It runs with `useDissolve` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Shatter (React Native):

```tsx
import { useDissolve } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, dissolving, dissolve } = useDissolve();

<View ref={ref} collapsable={false} style={{ opacity: dissolving ? 0 : 1 }}>
  <Card />
</View>

await dissolve({
  preset: 'shatter',
  duration: 1500,
  origin: { x: e.nativeEvent.locationX, y: e.nativeEvent.locationY },
  n: [220],
});
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'dust'` | Set it to `'shatter'`. |
| `origin` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'center' \| { x, y }` | `'center'` | Impact point. Pass the touch point (local coords) so the cracks start under the finger. |
| `n` | `[shards]` | `[220]` | Target shard count, clamped to 60..400. More shards read as tempered glass. |
| `velocity` | `{ x, y }` | `none` | Adds 30% of a swipe velocity (pt/s) to every shard launch. |
| `duration` | `number` | `1500` | Full effect length in ms. Shards fall with real gravity, so short durations keep them on screen. |
| `direction` | `'out' \| 'in'` | `'out'` | `'in'` plays the timeline backwards: the shards fly back and lock into the exact view. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | One rigid impact on the break, then light ticks while shards fly. |

## Best practices

- Use it for hard failures and irreversible breaks: wrong passcode, declined payment, broken link.
- Pass the touch point as origin, cracks starting under the finger sell the impact.
- Keep 120 to 260 shards on cards. 400 is for full width media.
- Do not use it for frequent actions, the flash and the gravity get tiring.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx

import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Stream

**Stream** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. The view flies into a target, like a file dropped in the trash. It runs with `useDissolve` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Stream (React Native):

```tsx
import { useDissolve } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, dissolving, dissolve } = useDissolve();

<View ref={ref} collapsable={false} style={{ opacity: dissolving ? 0 : 1 }}>
  <Card />
</View>

await dissolve({
  preset: 'stream',
  grain: 3.5,
  duration: 1500,
  to: binRef,
  onArrive: () => bumpBadge(),
});
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'dust'` | Set it to `'stream'`. |
| `to` | `RefObject<View> \| Box` | `tab bar` | Target the grains fly into: a ref (measured on the fly) or a window rect. Without it, the bottom center of the window. |
| `onArrive` | `() => void` | `none` | Called when most grains reach the target. Bump a badge or a counter here. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3.5` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `1500` | Full effect length in ms. |
| `origin` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'center' \| { x, y }` | `none` | Overrides the default order (closest grains to the target leave first). |
| `direction` | `'out' \| 'in'` | `'out'` | `'in'` pours out of the target to form the view. With `useAppear` pass `from: sourceRef`. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | Ticks as grains leave, one soft impact on arrival. |
| `field` | `'cascade'` | `none` | Replaces the native delay with a diagonal wave, for lists and full screens. |

## Best practices

- Use it to show where something went: a file into a folder, an item into the cart, a mail into the archive.
- Pass a ref as `to` and bump a badge in `onArrive`, the arrival is the payoff.
- Avoid targets hidden under other views, grains fly in a straight overlay above everything.
- Pair it with `direction: 'in'` and `from` to restore an item from the same place.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx

import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Gather

**Gather** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Grains converge from a loose cloud into the view. It runs with `DissolveIn` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Gather (React Native):

```tsx
import { DissolveIn } from 'dissolve-ui';

<DissolveIn
  preset="gather"
  grain={3}
  duration={1200}
>
  <Card />
</DissolveIn>
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'gather'` | Set it to `'gather'`. Any exit preset also works as an entrance. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `1200` | Full effect length in ms. Entrances default to 1200. |
| `origin` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'center' \| { x, y }` | `none` | Where the view starts to assemble. Without it the variant uses its own order. |
| `delay` | `number` | `0` | Wait before starting, in ms. Use `index * 40` to stagger a list. |
| `play` | `boolean` | `true` | `DissolveIn` only. Plays on mount; flip it from false to true to play later. |
| `onAppear` | `() => void` | `none` | `DissolveIn` only. Called once the real view is visible. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `false` | Entrances are quiet by default, lists can stagger many of them. |
| `field` | `'cascade'` | `none` | Replaces the native delay with a diagonal wave, for lists and full screens. |

## Best practices

- Use it for arrivals that deserve attention: a new message, a match, an unlocked reward.
- Wrap the new view in `<DissolveIn preset="gather">`, it plays on mount and reveals the real view at the end.
- Do not gather every row of a long list, stagger at most the first five with `delay`.
- Entrances are quiet by default, turn haptics on only for important arrivals.
- With reduced motion the view simply appears.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx

import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Rain

**Rain** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Grains fall and settle, bottom row first. It runs with `DissolveIn` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Rain (React Native):

```tsx
import { DissolveIn } from 'dissolve-ui';

<DissolveIn
  preset="rain"
  grain={3}
  duration={1200}
>
  <Card />
</DissolveIn>
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'gather'` | Set it to `'rain'`. Any exit preset also works as an entrance. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `1200` | Full effect length in ms. Entrances default to 1200. |
| `origin` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'center' \| { x, y }` | `none` | Where the view starts to assemble. Without it the variant uses its own order. |
| `delay` | `number` | `0` | Wait before starting, in ms. Use `index * 40` to stagger a list. |
| `play` | `boolean` | `true` | `DissolveIn` only. Plays on mount; flip it from false to true to play later. |
| `onAppear` | `() => void` | `none` | `DissolveIn` only. Called once the real view is visible. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `false` | Entrances are quiet by default, lists can stagger many of them. |
| `field` | `'cascade'` | `none` | Replaces the native delay with a diagonal wave, for lists and full screens. |

## Best practices

- Use it for content that loads in: refreshed feeds, search results, a grid of products.
- Stagger rows with `delay={index * 40}` for a falling wave.
- Avoid it for views at the very top of the screen, grains fall from above the view.
- 1000 to 1400 ms keeps the settle bounce crisp.
- With reduced motion the view simply appears.

# Snap

**Snap** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Bursts outward from the exact point you touched. It runs with `useDissolve` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Snap (React Native):

```tsx
import { useDissolve } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, dissolving, dissolve } = useDissolve();

<View ref={ref} collapsable={false} style={{ opacity: dissolving ? 0 : 1 }}>
  <Card />
</View>

await dissolve({
  preset: 'snap',
  grain: 3,
  duration: 1500,
  origin: { x: e.nativeEvent.locationX, y: e.nativeEvent.locationY },
  n: [1],
});
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'dust'` | Set it to `'snap'`. |
| `origin` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'center' \| { x, y }` | `'center'` | The burst point. Pass the touch point: `{ x: e.nativeEvent.locationX, y: e.nativeEvent.locationY }`. |
| `n` | `[push]` | `[1]` | Push strength multiplier. 0.6 is a gentle pop, 1.6 a blast. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `1500` | Full effect length in ms. |
| `direction` | `'out' \| 'in'` | `'out'` | `'in'` plays it backwards as an entrance. Use `DissolveIn` or `useAppear` for that. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | Soft impact, then a few ticks while the wave sweeps the view. |

## Best practices

- Use it for tap to dismiss: tags, chips, toasts and cards the user taps directly.
- Always pass the touch point as origin, otherwise it bursts from the center.
- Tune the push with `n: [push]`: 0.6 for small chips, 1.6 for hero cards.
- Do not trigger it from a separate button, the burst point would make no sense.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Fling

**Fling** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Follows the velocity of the swipe that threw it away. It runs with `useDissolve` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Fling (React Native):

```tsx
import { useDissolve } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, dissolving, dissolve } = useDissolve();

<View ref={ref} collapsable={false} style={{ opacity: dissolving ? 0 : 1 }}>
  <Card />
</View>

await dissolve({
  preset: 'fling',
  grain: 3,
  duration: 1500,
  velocity: { x: 2600, y: -200 },
});
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'dust'` | Set it to `'fling'`. |
| `velocity` | `{ x, y }` | `none` | Release velocity of the pan gesture in pt/s (`e.velocityX`, `e.velocityY`). Sets direction and strength. |
| `duration` | `number` | `auto` | Full effect length in ms. Without it, it follows the speed: clamp(1800 - speed * 0.4, 700, 1500). |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `origin` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'center' \| { x, y }` | `none` | Overrides the default order (the leading edge of the swipe leaves first). |
| `direction` | `'out' \| 'in'` | `'out'` | `'in'` plays it backwards as an entrance. Use `DissolveIn` or `useAppear` for that. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | Soft impact, then a few ticks while the wave sweeps the view. |
| `field` | `'cascade'` | `none` | Replaces the native delay with a diagonal wave, for lists and full screens. |

## Best practices

- Use it at the end of a swipe gesture: dismiss a card, triage a mail, reject a match.
- Pass the release velocity of the pan gesture, slow swipes drift, fast ones tear apart.
- Leave duration out so it follows the speed (700 to 1500 ms).
- Do not fling below about 300 pt/s, spring the card back instead.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

export default function Layout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Charge

**Charge** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Hold to heat the view up, it bursts at full charge. It runs with `useDissolveHold` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Charge (React Native):

```tsx
import { Pressable } from 'react-native';
import Animated from 'react-native-reanimated';
import { useDissolveHold } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, pressHandlers, style, charge } = useDissolveHold({
  holdMs: 1200,
  grain: 3,
  duration: 900,
  onCommit: () => remove(item.id),
});

<Pressable {...pressHandlers}>
  <Animated.View ref={ref} style={[styles.card, style]} />
</Pressable>
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `holdMs` | `number` | `1200` | Time to reach full charge. The view shakes, frays and heats on the way. |
| `then` | `VariantName` | `'charge'` | Variant of the final burst. Other variants only get the burst, no heat. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `900` | Full effect length in ms. Length of the final burst. |
| `maxDistance` | `number` | `24` | Finger travel in pt that cancels the hold. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | Ticks speed up from every 120 ms to every 30 ms, heavy impact at full charge. |
| `onCommit` | `() => void` | `none` | Called once the burst is over: remove the item here. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | `none` | Called when released early, once the view has settled back. |
| `n` | `[push]` | `[1]` | With `dissolve({ preset: 'charge' })`: push multiplier of the burst. |

## Best practices

- Use it to confirm destructive actions without a dialog: delete an account, wipe a project.
- Show the charge (the `charge` shared value) as a ring or a label so users know to keep holding.
- Keep holdMs between 800 and 1600. Shorter triggers by accident, longer feels broken.
- Do not use it for frequent actions, a hold on every delete gets tedious.
- With reduced motion the hold still works, only the burst is skipped.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

export default function Layout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Morph

**Morph** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. View A breaks down and rebuilds itself as view B. It runs with `useDissolveMorph` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Morph (React Native):

```tsx
import { useDissolveMorph } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { refA, refB, styleA, styleB, morph } = useDissolveMorph();

<View>
  <View style={styleA}><View ref={refA} collapsable={false}>{follow}</View></View>
  <View style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, styleB]}><View ref={refB} collapsable={false}>{following}</View></View>
</View>

await morph({ grain: 4, duration: 1100 });                // A becomes B
await morph({ grain: 4, duration: 1100, reverse: true }); // and back
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refA, refB` | `RefObject<View>` | `none` | The two views. Both stay mounted and laid out, stacked on top of each other. |
| `styleA, styleB` | `ViewStyle` | `none` | Put them on a wrapper of each view: the hidden one sits at 0.01 opacity so it can be captured. |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | `false` | Morph B back into A. |
| `grain` | `number` | `4` | Grain size in points, capped to 3500 grains per view (two atlases per morph). |
| `duration` | `number` | `1500` | Full effect length in ms. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | Soft impact, then a few ticks while the wave sweeps the view. |
| `phase` | `'a' \| 'morphing' \| 'b'` | `'a'` | Returned by the hook. Which view is showing. |

## Best practices

- Use it for state changes of the same element: Follow to Following, Download to Open, Add to In cart.
- Keep both views the same size and stacked, the grains pair by brightness.
- Avoid morphing two very different layouts, it reads as noise rather than a change.
- Grain 3 to 4 pt on buttons, the grain cap is halved because two atlases are drawn.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

export default function Layout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Peel

**Peel** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Peels off from the corner like a sticker, then flies away. It runs with `useDissolvePeel` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Peel (React Native):

```tsx
import { GestureDetector } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import Animated from 'react-native-reanimated';
import { useDissolvePeel } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, gesture, style } = useDissolvePeel({
  threshold: 0.4,
  grain: 3,
  duration: 700,
  onCommit: () => remove(sticker.id),
});

<GestureDetector gesture={gesture}>
  <Animated.View ref={ref} style={[styles.sticker, style]} />
</GestureDetector>
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `threshold` | `number` | `0.4` | useDissolvePeel: share of the view diagonal the corner must travel to commit. |
| `velocity` | `number` | `900` | useDissolvePeel: release speed in pt/s that commits regardless of distance. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `700` | Full effect length in ms. useDissolvePeel: fly off after a commit. With `dissolve()` it is the whole peel. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | A tick when the paper lifts, a light impact on commit. |
| `onCommit` | `() => void` | `none` | Called once the sticker is gone. |
| `onCancel` | `() => void` | `none` | Called when released early and the sticker is back in place. |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'dust'` | Auto mode: `dissolve({ preset: 'peel' })` peels from the bottom right corner. |
| `direction` | `'out' \| 'in'` | `'out'` | Auto mode: `'in'` sticks the sticker back on. |

## Best practices

- Made for stickers, badges and coupons: anything that should feel like paper.
- Prefer `useDissolvePeel`: the fold follows the finger from any corner or edge.
- Keep the default threshold (0.4) so a short pull springs back.
- Avoid it on views with a transparent background, the back of the sticker is a plain paper color.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

export default function Layout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```

# Melt

**Melt** is one of the 16 effects of dissolve, an animation library for React Native. Melts down in drips, like wax under a lamp. It runs with `useDissolve` from `dissolve-ui`.

## Usage

Melt (React Native):

```tsx
import { useDissolve } from 'dissolve-ui';

const { ref, dissolving, dissolve } = useDissolve();

<View ref={ref} collapsable={false} style={{ opacity: dissolving ? 0 : 1 }}>
  <Card />
</View>

await dissolve({
  preset: 'melt',
  grain: 3,
  duration: 1500,
});
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `VariantName` | `'dust'` | Set it to `'melt'`. |
| `grain` | `number` | `3` | Grain size in points. Raised automatically past about 6000 grains per burst. |
| `duration` | `number` | `1500` | Full effect length in ms. Drips need time: 1500 to 2500 reads best. |
| `direction` | `'out' \| 'in'` | `'out'` | `'in'` drips up and solidifies into the view. |
| `haptics` | `boolean` | `true` | Soft impact, then a few ticks while the wave sweeps the view. |

## Best practices

- Use it for playful or seasonal removals: weather alerts, ice, wax, expiring offers.
- Give it room below the view and 1500 to 2500 ms, drips merge and pinch off as they fall.
- Avoid it on small chips, the gooey layer needs some height to form drips.
- Colorful, flat views melt best, fine text blurs into the liquid.
- Reduced motion is handled by the provider: the effect is skipped and the promise resolves at once, so keep your state update after the `await`.

## Install

Install the package and its peers, then wrap the app once in `<DissolveProvider>`, above the navigator.

```sh
npx expo install dissolve-ui @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-gesture-handler expo-haptics
```

app/_layout.tsx:

```tsx
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { DissolveProvider } from 'dissolve-ui';

export default function Layout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <DissolveProvider>
        <Stack />
      </DissolveProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}
```
